_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA standalone metadata-fix cure spec (2026-07-19) — 3 KBLI-2025 codes (52101, 46100, 10433) with a HEALTHY, non-empty, OSS-native per_skala that must NEVER be detached, but whose canonical crosswalk metadata (status_mapping / intel_2026.whatChanged / pp28_sources) asserts a false narrative discovered during the Batch A Lot 2 conductor gate's cross-family Appendix A pass (2026-07-18). All three entries use the NEW 'action': 'metadata_only' spec-entry key (scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py, 2026-07-19 extension): this forces the compiler to skip per_skala/disputed-key handling ENTIRELY, regardless of the record's current per_skala state — the pre-existing (un-flagged) code path ALWAYS detaches a non-empty per_skala, which would be the wrong cure here (rule #9 detach>plausible-remap does not apply when the licensing data itself is verified correct and only the crosswalk-ancestor narrative is wrong). 52101 and 46100 get status_mapping_correction + whatChanged_correction (the Lot 2 mapping_metadata_false pattern, reused unmodified from PR #2761). 10433 gets the NEW pp28_sources_correction spec-entry key (also 2026-07-19 extension, mirroring status_mapping_correction exactly): its canonical pp28_sources=['10433','10490'] wrongly associates KBLI-2020 code 10490 with 10433 when BPS documents 10490 as the SOLE ancestor of a DIFFERENT 2025 code, 10419 (verified live in this session: 10419's own canonical kbli_2020_source='10490', pp28_sources=['10490']). None of the three touch per_skala, whatYouNeed, or any pma_status/l4_bali/TKA facet (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe unaffected — these are not detach cures, so the abstain rule that governs the detached-code honest-gap prose does not even apply here; the served licensing content is left completely as-is). This compiler NEVER authors a replacement licensing OR crosswalk-source value from plausibility (rule #9): every correction below is transcribed verbatim from an image-verified BPS Lampiran render already adjudicated at the SIGNED Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing + Appendix A) — this spec does not re-adjudicate anything, it only ships the write that report's §6.3/Appendix-A already authorized.
_provenance: Batch A Lot 2 conductor gate report (SIGNED, second signing + Appendix A, 2026-07-18): research/operations/2026-07-18-kbli-batch-a-lot2-conductor-gate.md (PR #2753) — §1 (46100 retro-quarantine, image-verify Lampiran 10 p.356, render lampiran10_p370-370.png), §3.3 (52101 five-parent MERGE, image-verify Lampiran 10 p.389, render lampiran10_p403-403.png), Appendix A (10433 disqualified POS control, image-verify Lampiran 10 p.326, render lampiran10_p340-340.png). §6.3 of that report schedules all three as 'standalone metadata-fix cures for BOTH controls (out-of-lot)' + '10433 joins the standalone metadata-fix cure list'. Crosswalk source: BPS Tabel Konversi Vol.2 (sha 29f17b3b) — same pin as Lot 1/2/3. Compiler extension ('action':'metadata_only', pp28_sources_correction) shipped in the same PR as this spec: scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py, tests in scripts/kbli_filiera/tests/test_cure_canonical_collisions.py.

codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 52101 'Pengelola Gudang Sistem Resi Gudang' (warehouse-receipt-system / SRG warehouse manager) carries canonical status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG' and intel_2026.whatChanged='Direct 1:1 match from KBLI 2020 — code and scope unchanged.' — both FALSE. This code was enrolled as a Lot 2 innocence CONTROL; the lane flagged it and the conductor image-verified BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 p.389 (render lampiran10_p403-403.png, Lot 2 conductor gate report §3.3, 2026-07-18) BY EYE: 52101-2025 is a FIVE-parent MERGE — KBLI-2020 codes 03143, 03241, 03243, 03263 (fishery post-harvest/production services) AND 52108 (same-title SRG warehouse manager) all map to KBLI-2025 52101 — not a direct 1:1 continuation. Its per_skala (8 rows) is HEALTHY OSS-native licensing, verified byte-for-byte against live OSS by the Lot 2 seat, and is NOT detached by this cure ('action':'metadata_only' — per_skala stays completely untouched regardless of its non-empty state). status_mapping corrected to 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' (the merge-aware enum value, already used 195+ times elsewhere in the dataset); intel_2026.whatChanged corrected to name the true parents. pp28_sources REMAINS ['52101'] UNCHANGED — a bare-number cross-vintage collision (the PP28 I.G row for '52101' describes the 2020 meaning, general warehousing/Rendah/NIB, not the 2025 SRG-manager/Tinggi-risk regime): fixing it would require an independent re-hunt of the PP28 corpus under the 5 true 2020 parents to establish a verified replacement source, which has NOT been performed in this session — forcing a pp28_sources change here without that provenance would violate rule #9 (no new values without provenance). This compiler's pp28_sources_correction capability (added in this same PR, first used on 10433 below) is therefore deliberately NOT applied to 52101; recorded here as a known follow-up, not silently left undocumented. Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing), 2026-07-18. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.
codes.whatChanged_correction: Renumbered/merged from KBLI 2020 52108 + fishery post-harvest services codes — activity scope from 52108, code number reused (corrected 2026-07-19 — the previous 'Direct 1:1 match... code and scope unchanged' label was a false narrative). BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 (image-verified p.389, render lampiran10_p403-403.png) documents a FIVE-parent merge: KBLI-2020 codes 03143, 03241, 03243, 03263 (fishery post-harvest/production services) and 52108 (same-title SRG warehouse manager) all map to KBLI-2025 52101. These five codes are recorded as crosswalk ancestors only — NOT injected into pp28_sources; pp28_sources remains ['52101'] unchanged.

codes.judul: Perdagangan Besar atas dasar Balas Jasa (Fee) atau Kontrak
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 46100 'Perdagangan Besar atas dasar Balas Jasa (Fee) atau Kontrak' (wholesale trade on a fee/commission-agent basis) carries canonical status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG' and intel_2026.whatChanged='Direct match from KBLI 2020 (MATCH_LANGSUNG). No code changes, no scope changes. The commission agent model has been stable across both classifications.' — both FALSE. This code was enrolled as a Lot 2 innocence CONTROL, lane-certified 'clean', and initially conductor-countersigned on a receipt-level review of the FORWARD table only — WRONG. Post-red-team the conductor read the REVERSE table (BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10, image-verified p.356, render lampiran10_p370-370.png, Lot 2 conductor gate report §1, 2026-07-18) BY EYE: 46100-2025 <- {46100, 63122} (2020) — a second parent, 63122 'Portal Web Dan/Atau Platform Digital Dengan Tujuan Komersial' (commercial web-portal / digital-platform activity), merges in. The lane's forward-table-only certified verdict AND the conductor's first receipt-level countersign both missed this reverse-table parent — recorded in the gate report as a gate-protocol lesson (receipt-level review without the reverse render is NOT a conductor verify). Its per_skala (15 rows) is HEALTHY OSS-native licensing and is NOT detached by this cure ('action':'metadata_only' — per_skala stays completely untouched regardless of its non-empty state). status_mapping corrected to 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE'; intel_2026.whatChanged corrected to name the true second parent. pp28_sources REMAINS ['46100'] UNCHANGED — 63122 is recorded here as a crosswalk ancestor only, NOT injected into pp28_sources (this compiler never authors new source values without independent PP28-corpus verification, same convention as 47771/52101). Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing), 2026-07-18. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.
codes.whatChanged_correction: Merged from multiple KBLI 2020 codes into a single 2025 code (corrected 2026-07-19 — the previous 'Direct match... No code changes, no scope changes' label was a false 1:1 narrative). BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 (image-verified p.356, render lampiran10_p370-370.png) documents a two-source merge in the reverse crosswalk direction: KBLI-2020 codes 46100 (Perdagangan Besar atas dasar Balas Jasa) and 63122 (Portal Web Dan/Atau Platform Digital Dengan Tujuan Komersial) both map to KBLI-2025 46100. 63122 is recorded here as a crosswalk ancestor only — NOT as a PP28 source; pp28_sources remains ['46100'] unchanged.

codes.judul: Industri Pemisahan/Fraksinasi Minyak Mentah Kelapa Sawit dan Minyak Mentah Inti Kelapa Sawit
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 10433 'Industri Pemisahan/Fraksinasi Minyak Mentah Kelapa Sawit dan Minyak Mentah Inti Kelapa Sawit' (CPO/PKO crude-oil fractionation industry) carries canonical pp28_sources=['10433','10490'], asserting BOTH KBLI-2020 codes 10433 and 10490 as its licensing basis. This code was sampled as a Lot 2 cross-family POSITIVE ('clean') gold control (Appendix A) and DISQUALIFIED: the conductor image-verified BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 printed p.326 (render lampiran10_p340-340.png, Lot 2 conductor gate report Appendix A, 2026-07-18) BY EYE: '10419 (2025) <- 10490 (2020)' and '10433 (2025) <- 10433 (2020)' are SEPARATE rows — 10490 is the SOLE KBLI-2020 ancestor of a DIFFERENT 2025 code, 10419 'Industri Minyak Mentah dan Lemak Nabati dan Hewani Bukan Kelapa dan Kelapa Sawit Lainnya' (independently verified live in this session: 10419's own canonical kbli_2020_source='10490', pp28_sources=['10490']), not a co-parent of 10433. The canonical pp28_sources=['10433','10490'] on 10433 therefore associates 10490 with the WRONG child code — the THIRD contaminated 'clean' control found that session (after 52101 and 46100), all on the crosswalk-metadata layer. Its per_skala (4 rows) is HEALTHY OSS-native licensing, unaffected by this crosswalk-pointer defect, and is NOT detached by this cure ('action':'metadata_only' — per_skala stays completely untouched regardless of its non-empty state). pp28_sources corrected to ['10433'] — 10490 REMOVED (it is recorded here as belonging to 10419, never re-added to 10433). status_mapping ('MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE') and intel_2026.whatChanged are left UNCHANGED by this cure: a single-element pp28_sources under a 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' status_mapping is an already-precedented dataset convention (47771, 52101, 60101, 60103 all carry the same shape — pp28_sources tracks the PP28-licensing-basis pointer only, separate from the full BPS crosswalk-ancestor narrative, which lives in prose), so no inconsistency is introduced; whether the merge-aware status_mapping label itself needs re-adjudication (given the 'aggregation' this code originally cited turns out, per this same finding, to have been built on a false co-parent) is flagged here as a known follow-up, not silently left undocumented — the scope of this cure is the pp28_sources removal only, per the task that authored it. This is the FIRST use of the pp28_sources_correction compiler capability, added in this same PR (scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py), mirroring the status_mapping_correction/whatChanged_correction pattern shipped for 47771 in PR #2761. Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing + Appendix A), 2026-07-18. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.

_whatYouNeed_doc: None of the three entries above carry a whatYouNeed key — unlike the Fase-1/Lot-1/Lot-2/Lot-3 detach specs, these are metadata_only cures: the served per_skala licensing content is verified HEALTHY and stays exactly as-is, only the crosswalk-metadata narrative (status_mapping/whatChanged/pp28_sources) is corrected. There is no honest-gap to disclose to the client because there is no gap — the licensing rows shown to the client are unaffected by this cure.
